snippet.description:
How should you actually choose the right UPSC teacher?

With short-form content and viral reels everywhere, it is easy to assume that the teacher with the most popular 5-minute clips must be the best teacher. But UPSC preparation requires more than a few impressive clips.

In this video, the discussion focuses on how UPSC beginners should evaluate GS Foundation teachers — by watching their complete lectures, understanding their teaching approach and asking an important question: Is the teaching actually exam-oriented?

Before choosing a UPSC GS Foundation Course, don’t judge a teacher only by reels or short videos. Look at the complete teaching experience and whether it helps you understand and answer UPSC-level questions.

If you are starting your UPSC 2027 or UPSC 2028 preparation, this is an important perspective to consider while choosing your teachers and GS Foundation program.
